text:
Leah (PM): quick sync: drafting a compact decision rubric for DP recruitment next quarter. goal = consistent signals + low ops churn.
Ravi (Eng): good. fewer high-touch partners means faster infra iterations.
Morgan (ProdOps): can we hard-cap active partners per sprint? ops bandwidth is the limiter. propose 6 active slots, 3 high-touch.
Eve (Research): scoring should favor partners who will run structured evals & share recordings. those are gold.
Noah (Design): also balance product surface: aim for at least one fintech, one health, one consumer app per wave.
Leah (PM): sketch weights: engagement_rate 30%, strategic_value 25%, domain_fit 20%, expected_feedback_depth 15%, compliance_risk 10%. open to tweaks.
Ravi (Eng): compliance risk should be a gating meta, not just a small penalty. if they need air-gapped infra, mark as "private-deploy" candidate.
Eve (Research): mini-formula for scoring (simple numbers 0-1):
```
score = 0.3*engage + 0.25*strategic + 0.2*domain + 0.15*feedback + 0.1*(1 - risk)
```
Noah (Design): add a soft "integration-value" flag for partners that will exercise key infra (vector DB, streaming, tool-calls). use to break ties.
Morgan (ProdOps): operational requirements: weekly check-ins, survey completion >=75%, demo recording each sprint. I'll add these as acceptance criteria in intake.
Leah (PM): recruitment timeline: shortlist by Fri, outreach next Mon, onboard wave 1 by end of month. 6-week engagement with check-ins at week 2 and week 5.
Ravi (Eng): intake should capture: avg prompt length, concurrency, calls/sec, sensitive data boolean, and primary SLA need (p95 latency). impacts model variant selection.
Eve (Research): intake Qs: "How will you measure success?" (choices: latency, cost, accuracy, UX), "Eval cadence?" (weekly/biweekly), "Do you record sessions?"
Noah (Design): success for DP->beta promotion: steady participation, no unresolved infra blockers, demonstrable win on at least one metric (e.g., 20% latency reduction or 10% accuracy lift).
Morgan (ProdOps): ops-bot: please schedule automated nudges at 48h before each mid-wave review.
ops-bot: reminder set — will ping assignees before checkpoints. :robot_face:
Leah (PM): action items: Morgan update intake + automations, Eve produce scoring sheet, Noah map vertical coverage targets, Ravi add infra fields to intake. I'll collate and publish a 1-pager.
Ravi (Eng): noted.
Eve (Research): will draft scoring sheet today.
Noah (Design): on it.
Morgan (ProdOps): updating now; will drop link in #product when ready.
Leah (PM): thanks team — aim to have a recruiting shortlist by next Tue. :thumbsup:
